Under $150: $9.95 standard; Alaska, Hawaii, US territories $25. A 'Change Country' footer link and a Zonos international script exist, but no destination list was read, so only US stored.

Company history page: William Dillard opened his first store in 1938 in Nashville, Arkansas; HQ relocated to Little Rock, Arkansas; 'the chain consists of 272 Dillard's stores including 28 clearance centers spanning 30 states'.
